verdict.rationale: xAI's API documents a first-party Remote MCP Tools feature that lets Grok connect to external MCP servers and use their custom tools, which is the client-side capability this story asks for. The evidence is a single summary sentence: it gives no configuration, authentication or transport details, and only remote servers are mentioned. Missing for 10: documented setup details (server URL/auth config, tool allow-listing), any evidence of local/stdio MCP server support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Remote MCP Tools allow Grok to connect to external MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, extending its capabilities with custom tools from third parties or your own implementations.
